maddeler.e:
أتخاطب (form VI)
# أَتَخَاطَبُ (ʔataḵāṭabu) /ʔa.ta.xaː.tˤa.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَخَاطَبَ (taḵāṭaba)
# أَتَخَاطَبَ (ʔataḵāṭaba) /ʔa.ta.xaː.tˤa.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَخَاطَبَ (taḵāṭaba)
# أَتَخَاطَبْ (ʔataḵāṭab) /ʔa.ta.xaː.tˤab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَخَاطَبَ (taḵāṭaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
